messages.text: Hey Allie! Your place would be perfect for a little get-together this Saturday around 3:30 — would you mind hosting? And it'd be great if you invited Jordan too, just whatever you feel like doing. Let me know!

Hey Sarah! Sounds fun — yes, my place works. Saturday at 3:30, I'll take care of it. I'll ask Jordan too, and let you know what they say. Anything you want me to have on hand (food, drinks)? I'll keep the afternoon free.
Hey Jordan! Sarah and I are doing a little get-together at my place this Saturday around 3:30 — would be great if you came. Let me know if you're in.

Hi! Could you tell me whether anything official is on the department schedule for this Saturday, and what's coming up next week? I'm planning something Saturday afternoon around 3:30 and want to avoid clashes. Thanks!
Amazing, thank you! Nothing special needed — maybe some snacks and drinks, whatever's easy. I can bring something too if that helps. See you Saturday!

Count me in! Saturday 15:30 works — my study session ends at 15:30 and I have dinner with family at 18:00, so I've put it in my calendar as 15:30-17:30. Tell me if it's meant to run later and I'll adjust. Where's your place again?

Hi Allie — nothing official is on the department schedule for this Saturday, so 3:30 pm that day has no official clash. Next week is also clear: no official events on record. (I only keep the official schedule; I can't speak to anyone's private plans.)

Great, glad you're in! 15:30-17:30 is exactly right — nothing runs that late, so you're clear for dinner at 18:00. My place: 1420 NE 45th St, apt 3B — a few blocks from campus, buzzer 3B. See you Saturday!

Perfect — I'll sort the snacks and drinks, so just bring yourself. If you have a favourite thing you'd like, bring that and I'll fill in the rest. Jordan's in: 15:30-17:30, then they head off to a family dinner. See you Saturday!
You're the best — thank you! I'll bring something to share. See you Saturday at 3:30.
Perfect — 1420 NE 45th St, apt 3B, buzzer 3B. Added the address to my calendar. See you Saturday!
Thanks, that's what I needed — no clash, then. Appreciate the quick answer!
